item.description: We have good news for Seattle readers! item.title: The Seattle Public Library responds to Feb. 23 Urbanist article

item.title: Learn About the Hidden Histories of Native American Activism on March 10
item.description: “How can a nation founded on the homelands of dispossessed Indigenous peoples be the world’s most exemplary democracy?” That is the question that opens Dr. Ned Blackhawk’s “The Rediscovery of America,” which won the 2023 National Book Award in Nonfiction.
